keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «인어가 마법 진주를 잃어버렸다(문제)» 와 «릴리가 진주를 찾아 주어 인어가 집에 돌아간다(해결)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (the mermaid lost her magic pearl) and the solution (Lily helps her get the pearl back, and she swims home). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: The mermaid lost her magic pearl, so she cannot go home.
Lily dives down and finds the pearl inside a big clam.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

qs.q: Why does Lily dive down deep?
opts: To find the mermaid’s lost pearl.
To look for her lost shoe.
evs: "I lost my magic pearl," says the mermaid.
Lily is swimming at the beach.
She looks under rocks and inside shells.
why: «"I lost my magic pearl," says the mermaid.» 인어가 마법 진주를 잃어버려서, 릴리는 진주를 찾으려고 깊이 잠수해요.
The mermaid lost her magic pearl, so Lily dives down deep to find it.

qs.q: "Lily dives down deep." What does "dives down deep" mean?
qs.qko: «Lily dives down deep.» 에서 «dives down deep» 은 무슨 뜻일까요?
opts: swims far down under the water
evs: She looks under rocks and inside shells.
She hears someone crying under the water.
why: «She looks under rocks and inside shells.» 릴리는 바닷속 바위 밑과 조개껍데기 안을 살펴봐요. 그러니 «dives down deep» 은 물속 깊이 내려간다는 뜻이에요.
Lily looks under rocks and inside shells at the bottom of the sea. So "dives down deep" means she swims far down under the water.

qs.q: Why can the mermaid go home at the end?
qs.qko: 마지막에 인어는 왜 집에 갈 수 있나요?
opts: Lily finds her magic pearl inside a big clam.
The mermaid learns to walk on land.
Lily buys her a new pearl from a shop.
evs: There it is, inside a big clam!
Lily is swimming at the beach.
why: 진주가 없으면 집에 갈 수 없었는데(«"Without it, I cannot go home."»), 릴리가 큰 조개 안에서 진주를 찾았어요(«There it is, inside a big clam!»). 그래서 집에 갈 수 있어요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
The mermaid cannot go home without her pearl, and Lily finds it inside a big clam. So she can go home. You need both sentences.

ends: The mermaid comes back to play with Lily at the beach.
인어가 해변으로 다시 와서 릴리와 함께 논다.
The mermaid gives Lily a magic shell that can talk.
인어가 릴리에게 말하는 마법 조개껍데기를 선물한다.

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «할 수 없는 일 + 대신 할 수 있는 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you can’t do and what you can do instead in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: 두 칸 모두 «하는 일» 낱말로 시작하게 써 보세요. (예: play soccer, draw a picture)
write.moreEn: One more step: start both blanks with an action word. (e.g. play soccer, draw a picture)
write.src: “I can’t <u>swim like a mermaid</u>, but I can <u>dive down deep</u>.”

img.cover: Deep under the clear blue sea, a girl with short curly brown hair in a red long-sleeved swim shirt, blue swim shorts and yellow goggles opens a giant clam and finds a glowing white pearl, while a little mermaid with long wavy purple hair, a pink ruffled top and a sparkly teal fish tail claps with joy beside her among bright corals and little fish.

scenes.1: In the shallow blue water near a sunny beach, a little mermaid with long wavy purple hair, a pink ruffled top and a sparkly teal fish tail sits on a rock with tears in her eyes and holds out her empty hands, and a girl with short curly brown hair in a red long-sleeved swim shirt, blue swim shorts and yellow goggles takes a big breath and dives down under the water.
scenes.2: Under the clear blue sea, a girl with short curly brown hair in a red long-sleeved swim shirt, blue swim shorts and yellow goggles hands a glowing white pearl from a big open clam to a little mermaid with long wavy purple hair, a pink ruffled top and a sparkly teal fish tail, who smiles and waves goodbye as she swims home.
